layman_headline: Market is ripping higher but nearly everything looks overextended — patience is the play.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market just had a massive rally week, with BTC up 22%, ETH up 28%, and many altcoins up 30-60%. Our SOL position is up nearly 7% and approaching its profit target of $100. Our XRP position is underwater at -7% after we entered near a local top, but it hasn't hit the stop-loss yet. With the Fear & Greed index at 71 (Greed) and almost every candidate showing signs of being overextended, chasing new positions here carries high risk of buying the top.
layman_action: Hold current positions. SOL is working — let it run toward the $100 target. Watch XRP closely; if it drops to $1.30, the stop-loss will trigger. Don't chase any of the massive movers right now.
expert_reasoning: Every swing candidate in this cycle is either a stablecoin (no trade), or has already moved 23-67% in 7 days with negative composite signal scores. PUMP has RSI 75 (overbought), MON is below its SMA20 despite a 32% weekly move suggesting weakness, and ZEC/XRP/HYPE/VVV are all massively extended. BTC dominance at 58.9% signals that capital is concentrating in BTC rather than flowing freely to alts — a headwind for new alt entries. The Fear & Greed index improving from 51 weekly average to 71 suggests the easy money in this leg has been made. SOL at $93.21 is 7% from its $100 exit target and the position is healthy. XRP at -7.1% is concerning but still above its $1.30 stop-loss; the 43.6% weekly move suggests it could bounce but the entry was poorly timed.
risk_factors: XRP could deteriorate further toward its $1.30 stop-loss if the broader rally pauses or reverses
A sharp BTC correction from these levels (up 22% in one week) would drag all alts down including SOL
Fear & Greed at 71 and rising could signal a local top forming, with potential for a mean-reversion pullback
watch_list: SOL price action near $95-100 resistance zone — be ready to take profit if momentum stalls
XRP behavior around $1.40 support — a break below could accelerate toward the $1.30 stop-loss
BTC ability to hold above $75,000 — a breakdown would signal the squeeze rally is over
market_context: The crypto market just experienced a massive squeeze-led rally with BTC up 22% weekly and broad altcoin strength. Fear & Greed has surged from 51 to 71, putting us in Greed territory where caution is warranted for new entries.
context_banner: Post-squeeze market is overheated — manage existing winners and let the dust settle before adding risk.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed surged from weekly avg of 51 to 71 (Greed), suggesting the rally may be approaching exhaustion and new entries carry elevated risk.
PUMP RSI at 75 is overbought; MON RSI at 41 is interesting but price is below SMA20, indicating the pullback may deepen — no clean entries available.
BTC and ETH bears got 'decimated' in a squeeze-led rally — confirms the move was short-covering driven, which tends to exhaust quickly.
Ray Dalio recommending 'a bit' of Bitcoin amid debt crisis concerns provides macro tailwind but the move has already been priced in this week.
ZEC volume at $2.4B with a 61% weekly move and Grayscale ETF buzz is notable, but chasing a 20% daily move is not a swing trade setup — it's FOMO.
